Verbatim plan content is rendered with no escaping contract covering it. The composition spec escaping contract is scoped to trailer values; this spec renders plan-file content as "opaque, reproduced verbatim" qualifiers and rung-2 offending lines, with no character restriction beyond excluding ")".
